verses.original: שִׁמְע֣וּ בָ֭נִים מ֣וּסַר אָ֑ב וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבוּ לָדַ֥עַת בִּינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ḇā·nîm mū·sar ’āḇ wə·haq·šî·ḇū lā·ḏa·‘aṯ bî·nāh
verses.literal: Listen my sons to a father’s instruction pay attention and gain understanding
verses.literalPt: OUVI, filhos, a instrução do pai, e estai atentos para conhecerdes a prudência.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֶ֣קַח ט֭וֹב נָתַ֣תִּי לָכֶ֑ם תּֽ֝וֹרָתִ֗י אַֽל־ תַּעֲזֹֽבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî le·qaḥ ṭō·wḇ nā·ṯat·tî lā·ḵem tō·w·rā·ṯî ’al- ta·‘ă·zō·ḇū
verses.literal: For I give you sound teaching do not abandon my directive
verses.literalPt: Pois dou-vos boa doutrina; não deixeis a minha lei.

verses.original: כִּי־ בֵ֭ן הָיִ֣יתִי לְאָבִ֑י רַ֥ךְ וְ֝יָחִ֗יד לִפְנֵ֥י אִמִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḇên hā·yî·ṯî lə·’ā·ḇî raḵ wə·yā·ḥîḏ lip̄·nê ’im·mî
verses.literal: When I was a son to my father tender and the only child of my mother
verses.literalPt: Porque eu era filho tenro na companhia de meu pai, e único diante de minha mãe.

verses.original: וַיֹּרֵ֗נִי וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לִ֗י יִֽתְמָךְ־ דְּבָרַ֥י לִבֶּ֑ךָ שְׁמֹ֖ר מִצְוֺתַ֣י וֶֽחְיֵֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·rê·nî way·yō·mer lî yiṯ·māḵ- də·ḇā·ray lib·be·ḵā šə·mōr miṣ·wō·ṯay weḥ·yêh
verses.literal: he taught me and said Let your heart lay hold of my words keep my commands and you will live
verses.literalPt: E ele me ensinava e me dizia: Retenha o teu coração as minhas palavras; guarda os meus mandamentos, e vive.

verses.original: קְנֵ֣ה חָ֭כְמָה קְנֵ֣ה בִינָ֑ה אַל־ תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח וְאַל־ תֵּ֝֗ט מֵֽאִמְרֵי־ פִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: qə·nêh ḥāḵ·māh qə·nêh ḇî·nāh ’al- tiš·kaḥ wə·’al- têṭ mê·’im·rê- p̄î
verses.literal: Get wisdom get understanding do not forget . . . my words . . . or turn from them
verses.literalPt: Adquire sabedoria, adquire inteligência, e não te esqueças nem te apartes das palavras da minha boca.

verses.original: אַל־ תַּעַזְבֶ֥הָ וְתִשְׁמְרֶ֑ךָּ אֱהָבֶ֥הָ וְתִצְּרֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- ta·‘az·ḇe·hā wə·ṯiš·mə·re·kā ’ĕ·hā·ḇe·hā wə·ṯiṣ·ṣə·re·kā
verses.literal: Do not forsake wisdom and she will preserve you love her and she will guard you
verses.literalPt: Não a abandones e ela te guardará; ama-a, e ela te protegerá.

verses.original: רֵאשִׁ֣ית חָ֭כְמָה קְנֵ֣ה חָכְמָ֑ה וּבְכָל־ קִ֝נְיָנְךָ֗ קְנֵ֣ה בִינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rê·šîṯ ḥāḵ·māh qə·nêh ḥāḵ·māh ū·ḇə·ḵāl qin·yā·nə·ḵā qə·nêh ḇî·nāh
verses.literal: Wisdom is supreme so acquire wisdom And whatever you may acquire gain understanding
verses.literalPt: A sabedoria é a coisa principal; adquire pois a sabedoria, emprega tudo o que possuis na aquisição de entendimento.

verses.original: סַלְסְלֶ֥הָ וּֽתְרוֹמְמֶ֑ךָּ תְּ֝כַבֵּ֗דְךָ כִּ֣י תְחַבְּקֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: sal·sə·le·hā ū·ṯə·rō·wm·me·kā tə·ḵab·bê·ḏə·ḵā kî ṯə·ḥab·bə·qen·nāh
verses.literal: Prize her and she will exalt you if you embrace her she will honor you
verses.literalPt: Exalta-a, e ela te exaltará; e, abraçando-a tu, ela te honrará.

verses.original: תִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭רֹאשְׁךָ לִוְיַת־ חֵ֑ן עֲטֶ֖רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת תְּמַגְּנֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: tit·tên lə·rō·šə·ḵā liw·yaṯ- ḥên ‘ă·ṭe·reṯ tip̄·’e·reṯ tə·mag·gə·ne·kā
verses.literal: She will set a garland of grace on your head she will present you with a crown of beauty
verses.literalPt: Dará à tua cabeça um diadema de graça e uma coroa de glória te entregará.

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ֭נִי וְקַ֣ח אֲמָרָ֑י וְיִרְבּ֥וּ לְ֝ךָ֗ שְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘ bə·nî wə·qaḥ ’ă·mā·rāy wə·yir·bū lə·ḵā šə·nō·wṯ ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: Listen my son and receive my words and the years of your life will be many
verses.literalPt: Ouve, filho meu, e aceita as minhas palavras, e se multiplicarão os anos da tua vida.

verses.original: בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ חָ֭כְמָה הֹרֵתִ֑יךָ הִ֝דְרַכְתִּ֗יךָ בְּמַעְגְּלֵי־ יֹֽשֶׁר׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḏe·reḵ ḥāḵ·māh hō·rê·ṯî·ḵā hiḏ·raḵ·tî·ḵā bə·ma‘·gə·lê- yō·šer
verses.literal: I will guide you in the way of wisdom I will lead you on straight paths
verses.literalPt: No caminho da sabedoria te ensinei, e por veredas de retidão te fiz andar.

verses.original: בְּֽ֭לֶכְתְּךָ לֹא־ יֵצַ֣ר צַעֲדֶ֑ךָ וְאִם־ תָּ֝ר֗וּץ לֹ֣א תִכָּשֵֽׁל׃
verses.transliteration: bə·leḵ·tə·ḵā lō- yê·ṣar ṣa·‘ă·ḏe·ḵā wə·’im- tā·rūṣ lō ṯik·kā·šêl
verses.literal: When you walk your steps will not be impeded when you run you will not stumble
verses.literalPt: Por elas andando, não se embaraçarão os teus passos; e se correres não tropeçarás.

verses.original: הַחֲזֵ֣ק בַּמּוּסָ֣ר אַל־ תֶּ֑רֶף נִ֝צְּרֶ֗הָ כִּי־ הִ֥יא חַיֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥă·zêq bam·mū·sār ’al- te·rep̄ niṣ·ṣə·re·hā kî- hî ḥay·ye·ḵā
verses.literal: Hold on to instruction do not let go Guard it for it is your life
verses.literalPt: Apega-te à instrução e não a largues; guarda-a, porque ela é a tua vida.

verses.original: בְּאֹ֣רַח רְ֭שָׁעִים אַל־ תָּבֹ֑א וְאַל־ תְּ֝אַשֵּׁ֗ר בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ רָעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’ō·raḥ rə·šā·‘îm ’al- tā·ḇō wə·’al- tə·’aš·šêr bə·ḏe·reḵ rā·‘îm
verses.literal: Do not set foot on the path of the wicked or walk in the way of evildoers
verses.literalPt: Não entres pela vereda dos ímpios, nem andes no caminho dos maus.

verses.original: פְּרָעֵ֥הוּ אַל־ תַּעֲבָר־ בּ֑וֹ שְׂטֵ֖ה מֵעָלָ֣יו וַעֲבֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: pə·rā·‘ê·hū ’al- ta·‘ă·ḇār- bōw śə·ṭêh mê·‘ā·lāw wa·‘ă·ḇō·wr
verses.literal: Avoid it do not travel on it Turn from it and pass on by
verses.literalPt: Evita-o; não passes por ele; desvia-te dele e passa de largo.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א יִֽ֭שְׁנוּ אִם־ לֹ֣א יָרֵ֑עוּ וְֽנִגְזְלָ֥ה שְׁ֝נָתָ֗ם אִם־ לֹ֥א יִכְשׁוֹלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō yiš·nū ’im- lō yā·rê·‘ū wə·niḡ·zə·lāh šə·nā·t̲ām ’im- lō yiḵ·šō·lū
verses.literal: For they cannot sleep unless . . . they do evil they are deprived of slumber until . . . they make someone fall
verses.literalPt: Pois não dormem, se não fizerem mal, e foge deles o sono se não fizerem alguém tropeçar.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לָ֭חֲמוּ לֶ֣חֶם רֶ֑שַׁע וְיֵ֖ין חֲמָסִ֣ים יִשְׁתּֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî lā·ḥă·mū le·ḥem re·ša‘ wə·yên ḥă·mā·sîm yiš·tū
verses.literal: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence
verses.literalPt: Porque comem o pão da impiedade, e bebem o vinho da violência.

verses.original: וְאֹ֣רַח צַ֭דִּיקִים כְּא֣וֹר נֹ֑גַהּ הוֹלֵ֥ךְ וָ֝א֗וֹר עַד־ נְכ֥וֹן הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ō·raḥ ṣad·dî·qîm kə·’ō·wr nō·ḡah hō·w·lêḵ wā·’ō·wr ‘aḏ- nə·ḵō·wn hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: The path of the righteous is like the first gleam . . . of dawn shining brighter and brighter until midday . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas a vereda dos justos é como a luz da aurora, que vai brilhando mais e mais até ser dia perfeito.

verses.original: דֶּ֣רֶךְ רְ֭שָׁעִים כָּֽאֲפֵלָ֑ה לֹ֥א יָ֝דְע֗וּ בַּמֶּ֥ה יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: de·reḵ rə·šā·‘îm kā·’ă·p̄ê·lāh lō yā·ḏə·‘ū bam·meh yik·kā·šê·lū
verses.literal: But the way of the wicked is like the darkest gloom they do not know what makes them stumble
verses.literalPt: O caminho dos ímpios é como a escuridão; nem sabem em que tropeçam.

verses.original: בְּ֭נִי לִדְבָרַ֣י הַקְשִׁ֑יבָה לַ֝אֲמָרַ֗י הַט־ אָזְנֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nî liḏ·ḇā·ray haq·šî·ḇāh la·’ă·mā·ray haṭ- ’ā·zə·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: My son pay attention to my words incline your ear to my sayings
verses.literalPt: Filho meu, atenta para as minhas palavras; às minhas razões inclina o teu ouvido.

verses.original: אַל־ יַלִּ֥יזוּ מֵעֵינֶ֑יךָ שָׁ֝מְרֵ֗ם בְּת֣וֹךְ לְבָבֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- yal·lî·zū mê·‘ê·ne·ḵā šā·mə·rēm bə·ṯō·wḵ lə·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā
verses.literal: Do not lose sight of them keep them within your heart
verses.literalPt: Não as deixes apartar-se dos teus olhos; guarda-as no íntimo do teu coração.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חַיִּ֣ים הֵ֭ם לְמֹצְאֵיהֶ֑ם וּֽלְכָל־ בְּשָׂר֥וֹ מַרְפֵּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥay·yîm hêm lə·mō·ṣə·’ê·hem ū·lə·ḵāl- bə·śā·rōw mar·pê
verses.literal: For they are life to those who find them and health to the whole body
verses.literalPt: Porque são vida para os que as acham, e saúde para todo o seu corpo.

verses.original: מִֽכָּל־ מִ֭שְׁמָר נְצֹ֣ר לִבֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־ מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ תּוֹצְא֥וֹת חַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: mik·kāl miš·mār nə·ṣōr lib·be·ḵā kî- mim·men·nū tō·wṣ·’ō·wṯ ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: Guard your heart with all diligence for from it flow springs of life
verses.literalPt: Sobre tudo o que se deve guardar, guarda o teu coração, porque dele procedem as fontes da vida.

verses.original: הָסֵ֣ר מִ֭מְּךָ עִקְּשׁ֣וּת פֶּ֑ה וּלְז֥וּת שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם הַרְחֵ֥ק מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·sêr mim·mə·ḵā ‘iq·qə·šūṯ peh ū·lə·zūṯ śə·p̲ā·t̲a·yim har·ḥêq mim·me·kā
verses.literal: Put away deception from your mouth keep . . . your lips from perverse speech
verses.literalPt: Desvia de ti a falsidade da boca, e afasta de ti a perversidade dos lábios.

verses.original: עֵ֭ינֶיךָ לְנֹ֣כַח יַבִּ֑יטוּ וְ֝עַפְעַפֶּ֗יךָ יַיְשִׁ֥רוּ נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·ne·ḵā lə·nō·ḵaḥ yab·bî·ṭū wə·‘ap̄·‘ap·pe·ḵā yay·ši·rū neḡ·de·ḵā
verses.literal: Let your eyes look forward fix your gaze straight ahead
verses.literalPt: Os teus olhos olhem para a frente, e as tuas pálpebras olhem direto diante de ti.

verses.original: פַּ֭לֵּס מַעְגַּ֣ל רַגְלֶ֑ךָ וְֽכָל־ דְּרָכֶ֥יךָ יִכֹּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: pal·lês ma‘·gal raḡ·le·ḵā wə·ḵāl də·rā·ḵe·ḵā yik·kō·nū
verses.literal: Make a level path for your feet and all your ways will be sure
verses.literalPt: Pondera a vereda de teus pés, e todos os teus caminhos sejam bem ordenados!

verses.original: אַֽל־ תֵּט־ יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול הָסֵ֖ר רַגְלְךָ֣ מֵרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- têṭ- yā·mîn ū·śə·mō·wl hā·sêr raḡ·lə·ḵā mê·rā‘
verses.literal: Do not swerve to the right or to the left turn your feet away from evil
verses.literalPt: Não declines nem para a direita nem para a esquerda; retira o teu pé do mal.
